name: VV WaveSpeed Generation — Ledger Guarded (First Paid Test)

nodes.name: Manual Trigger
nodes.notes: MANUAL ONLY. No schedule trigger exists in this workflow. Do not add one for the first paid test.

nodes.name: Job Request (edit before run)
nodes.notes: Edit here. model_inputs = the exact JSON inputs sent to WaveSpeed (must match the inputs used for the price check). confirm_paid stays NOT-APPROVED for dry runs; only APPROVED-BY-LUCY arms the single paid POST for the FIRST paid test.

nodes.name: Build Job + Static Guards
nodes.notes: Static guards: batch size <= 1, model allowlist, required fields, no placeholders. Builds the deterministic generation_job_id.

nodes.name: Result — Rejected Before Ledger
nodes.notes: Terminal. Nothing written to the ledger. No network call made.

nodes.name: Ledger: Insert CREATED
nodes.notes: Every attempt inserts its OWN row first (state CREATED). The row id orders concurrent attempts.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model_id: $('Build Job + Static Guards').first().json.model, inputs: JSON.parse($('Build Job + Static Guards').first().json.model_inputs_json) }) }}

nodes.name: WaveSpeed Price Check (non-paid)
nodes.notes: NON-PAID pricing lookup. Retries allowed. Any failure → FAILED_CLEAN, no paid POST.

nodes.name: Ledger: Read All Rows
nodes.notes: Reads the whole durable ledger (small table). Used for duplicate, concurrency and daily-spend guards.

nodes.name: Ledger Guards (duplicate / concurrency / budget)
nodes.notes: DUPLICATE_GENERATION_BLOCKED / CONCURRENCY_GUARD_BLOCKED / BUDGET_GUARD_BLOCKED ($0.25 per generation, $10.00 per day) / BUDGET_APPROVED.

nodes.name: First-Test Arming Switch
nodes.notes: FIRST PAID TEST ONLY. Default NOT-APPROVED ends the run as a dry run (FAILED_CLEAN, nothing billed).

nodes.name: Ledger: Pre-POST Re-read
nodes.notes: Second read immediately before claiming SUBMITTING.

nodes.name: Ledger: Write SUBMITTING
nodes.notes: SUBMITTING is written to the durable ledger BEFORE the paid POST.

nodes.name: Verify SUBMITTING Persisted
nodes.notes: The paid POST is only reachable if exactly one ledger row now reads SUBMITTING for this attempt.

nodes.name: WaveSpeed Paid POST (single attempt, NO RETRY)
nodes.notes: THE ONLY PAID CALL. Single attempt: retryOnFail=false. Reachable from exactly one path. Never connected to the polling loop.

nodes.name: Classify Paid POST Result
nodes.notes: Uncertain outcome → PAYMENT_STATE_UNKNOWN. There is no retry path back to the paid POST.

nodes.name: Poll Context
nodes.notes: Loop entry. Inputs: Write SUBMITTED (first) and Write PROCESSING (loop). Never connects back to the paid POST.

nodes.name: WaveSpeed Status GET (retry allowed)
nodes.notes: Status GET only. Retries allowed.

nodes.name: Evaluate Poll Result
nodes.notes: completed + output → ASSET_CANDIDATE. Remote failure or poll limit → PAYMENT_STATE_UNKNOWN (human reconciles).

nodes.name: Ledger: Write PROCESSING
nodes.notes: Loops back to Poll Context only.

nodes.name: Ledger: Write Terminal State
nodes.notes: Single terminal writer for every outcome. approved=false, published=false, requires_human_approval=true.

nodes.name: Final Result
nodes.notes: Successful generation terminates as ASSET_CANDIDATE with approved=false, published=false, requires_human_approval=true. Nothing is published.

main.node: WaveSpeed Paid POST (single attempt, NO RETRY)
